critical_decisions: Exact kernel-owned GFP_KERNEL DMA API handles; no manual DMA aliases or foreign pointers. BIDI source permissions are RW, immutability is software-owner contract/full bytes, not hardware RO.
4x4MiB then 8x2MiB then ordinary noncontiguous fallback; all partial-success allocations use checked release; failed allocation-internal unwind is an explicit unextended legacy limitation.
Actual hostSv39 leaves, raw PTEs/table PAs, all 4KiB CPU/PA identities and physical nonalias checked before DMA; legal large leaves preserved, segmentation does not force small mappings.
Four physical pools, one authorized DMA0 owner, global experiment lock, HPM same-task ownership, built-in provider, stable/suppressed bindings and no concurrent foreign map/unmap.

Existing frozen register frontend waits each hardware 4KiB task; max aligned AW outstanding2 respects W-credit boundary; whole-batch NEXT/DONE functional identity separate from local task observation IDs.
Observer complete432 issue/done across all batches, final poll word9=1/status4, accept-return/outstanding and composition conservation; no invented per-beat traces.
CVA6 single-hart FENCE.I owner handoff, checked prep hostS1 barrier once; maps/IOTLB preserved across phases. Preparation checked-fence failure quarantines and cannot retry/revoke/free.

Prior swapout and full restore separated; full all-byte CPU/GPU and inactive/backing guard checks. Worker/layer ready follows actual DMA completion, CPU reacquire and per-layer full K/V consumer check; joint count after both workers.
Unknown NEXT, unproven STOP/drain/globalquiet, release failure retain complete private owner/device resources until reboot; STOP is not AXI cancellation.
Teardown preflights whole batch, unmaps actual leaves, checks every4KiB absent, publishes PTE stores/completes checked IOFENCE, only then frees IOVA/debug/backing. No second legacy void unmap.

Kernel raw cycle/time stamps and nominal ns plus board userspace nominal phases; Dell independent monotonic wraps deployment/pilot/calibration separately. Stage11 ends before final struct copy; userspace syscall interval includes it.
